info.name: IoT Connect - Interview Evidence
info.description: Two read-only application APIs for the live IoT Connect demo. These are the same account APIs used by the web application. No headers, credentials, request bodies, or internal UUIDs are required.

request.description: The real application GET for Aster's IoT subscriptions. Newly activated subscriptions appear with ACTIVE status, activation timestamp, and source batch number.

item.name: 2 - GET Boreal account summary and billing mode

request.description: The real application GET for Boreal's account summary. The nested account object shows billing_mode and send_subscriptions_to_amdocs before and after the summarized-billing change.
The operator application's real batch-history GET. It automatically saves the newest batch_id for the next request.

item.name: 4 - GET FlowOne and Legacy Billing outcomes

request.description: The application's real batch-detail GET. It shows FlowOne network-element results plus the Legacy Billing submission or policy-skip outcome for every SIM.
